what: Live Arweave data-availability: the solver uploaded the solution to real Arweave (Irys devnet), bound keccak(txid) as the on-chain commitDaHash, and the INDEPENDENT operator located it on Arweave by CID, fetched it from the public gateway, and re-verified — replacing the local placeholder with a real provider.
operator_check: located by CID on Arweave, fetched from gateway, re-ran verifier -> valid=true (honest, no challenge)
honest_caveats: Irys DEVNET: real network + gateway + GraphQL, free for small blobs, but data retained ~60 days — mainnet Arweave (funded) is required for true permanence (Phase 2+).
The permanence receipt at finalize is still a placeholder; only the commit-time DA is on live Arweave here.
Availability is proven by fetching now; a real 'remains-available-forever' guarantee needs Arweave mainnet + an availability-sampling/slashing market.
